risks.title: Geographic concentration and dependence on the Italian market
risks.score_rationale: Banco BPM operates primarily in Italy (1,436 branches, including 1,382 Banco BPM) with minor presence abroad (Switzerland, Hong Kong, Mumbai). This concentration exposes the group to Italian economic cycles and intense local banking competition. Major structural risk for a regional bank.

risks.title: Post-merger fragmentation and operational integration
risks.score_rationale: Complex structure post-merger (Banco BPM, Banca Aletti, Banca Akros, specialized subsidiaries) with multiple business lines and associated entities. Risk of operational inefficiency, duplication, and high integration costs. Moderate language but structure reveals organizational complexity.

risks.title: Regulatory risk and strict banking compliance
risks.score_rationale: Banco BPM operates under ECB/Bank of Italy supervision with capital requirements (Basel III), AML/KYC, and GDPR compliance explicitly mentioned. Frequent regulatory changes in the EU impact costs and business model. High risk for the banking sector.

risks.title: Cybersecurity and digital technology risks
risks.score_rationale: Document mentions 'Technological projects and investments' (p.142) and digital 'Communication'. Bank exposed to cyberattacks, online fraud, and IT system dependency. Growing risk for the financial sector with accelerated digitalization.

risks.title: Dependence on talent and human resource management
risks.score_rationale: Section 'Human resources' (p.133) and incentive plans (share-based compensation, agenda items 5.1-5.2) indicate HR importance. Risk of turnover, loss of key skills, and high retention costs in a competitive sector.

risks.title: Credit risk and loan portfolio quality
risks.score_rationale: Banco BPM is a retail/corporate bank with significant exposure to loans to Italian SMEs and individuals. Economic crisis, unemployment, or payment defaults deteriorate credit quality. Major structural risk for a universal bank.

risks.title: Increased competition from fintech and digital banks
risks.score_rationale: Banco BPM is a traditional bank facing digital disruption (fintech, neobanks, tech giants). Business model based on physical network (1,436 branches) vulnerable to margin erosion and customer loss. Trend 'up': growing threat.

risks.title: Reputational risk and AML/sanctions compliance
risks.score_rationale: Section 'Anti-money laundering' (p.141) is explicit. Italian banks historically exposed to AML/sanctions risks. Violations lead to massive fines, loss of customer trust, and regulatory restrictions. Major reputational risk.
